name: otp-field
title: OTP Field
description: An animated one-time code field for React and shadcn, with autofill and paste across every cell.

meta.details: A one-time-code input on Base UI's OTPField: autofill and paste fill every cell, the caret blinks in the empty cell, characters pop in, a wrong code shakes once and an accepted one ripples green.

docs: Import OtpField from components/eased/otp-field/otp-field; wrap it in Field for a label and messages. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import.
